common.tagline: Givin homeworld of geometric architects, in tense Imperial protectorate.
common.famousFor: Givin shipwrights and structural engineers. The most precise mathematics in the Outer Rim.
common.cantinaReputation: Homeworld of the Givin — vacuum-adapted mathematicians with sealed exoskeletons. Yag'Dhul's three moons create extreme tidal forces that periodically strip the atmosphere from low-lying areas. The Givin are master shipwrights and hyperspace theorists. In 15 BBY, Yag'Dhul Station is a refueling stop on the Rimma Trade Route, and Givin navigators can be hired for complex route calculations.
